query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.user_type, mp.id as mentor_profile_id, mp.university, mp.major, mp.grade, mp.is_active
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON u.id = mp.userId
WHERE u.name LIKE '%이윤호%'
LIMIT 5;
